item.title: Issue #3051 created
item.description:
`fn:type-of`: records

I forgot to mention in our weekly that I believe we should omit the record( and ) packaging in the fn:type-of output (see https://github.com/qt4cg/qtspecs/pull/3028#issuecomment-6562672549):

All other output strings can be copied and pasted as type information; I think this should also apply to record types.
